title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description:
For a string s, find the length of its longest contiguous run in which no character occurs twice. Characters are case-sensitive: the capital A and lowercase a are different. Return the length only, not the substring or its starting position. If the input has no characters, the answer is 0.

Grow a window at its right edge. If the new character was previously seen inside that window, move the left edge to just past its latest occurrence. Earlier starting positions all retain the duplicate and cannot yield a valid window with the current right edge, so the left edge never needs to move backward. Track the latest index of each character to avoid rescanning the current substring.

A substring must occupy consecutive positions: selecting isolated distinct characters is not permitted. Repeated characters seen before the present window do not force it to shrink. For example, a second appearance of a character at an index already left behind should not undo progress.

Example 1:

Input: s = "abcabcbb"
Output: 3

Example 2:

Input: s = "bbbbb"
Output: 1

Example 3:

Input: s = ""
Output: 0

Constraints:

  • 0 <= s.length <= 100,000
  • s consists of printable ASCII characters (including spaces)
  • uppercase and lowercase are distinct

exampleTestCases.explanation: The empty string has no run.
